learning_outcomes.text: reproduce the functions of the anatomical and physiological building blocks of the human body and apply them to biomechanical and sports medical questions.
describe the structure of the cell and various tissue types.
describe the structure of the bone and muscle system.
describe the functioning of the heart-lung system and blood circulation.
analyze and evaluate the interactions of the systems in relation to different states of movement.
make predictions regarding the stress of various movement sequences on the human body and its resilience.
make decisions regarding potentially occurring damage to the organism.

assessment_rules: The prerequisite is proper registration with the examination office. Attendance at the event is not strictly required. The content is assessed via a 60-minute written exam.
